description: This PHP file defines the Order class within the OpenCart admin dashboard extension. It manages the display and configuration of the order dashboard widget, including rendering views, saving settings, and generating dashboard data.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class for managing the order dashboard widget, including rendering the order view, saving configuration, and providing dashboard statistics.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the order dashboard widget view, setting up breadcrumbs, configuration options, and layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the dashboard widget configuration settings, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Generates and returns the order statistics for the dashboard, including total orders and percentage change.
